text: You wake up... and every other human on Earth is gone.
Watch till the end. The thing that breaks you first... isn't hunger.
Hour one. No cars. No voices.
At first... it feels like freedom.
Every store... every house... is yours.
Within a day, the power plants start shutting down.
One by one... the lights go out.
The whole planet goes dark.
Day two. The subway tunnels start to flood.
Day three. No signal. You're cut off from everything.
No news. No one is coming to help.
Week one. The hungry dogs... start hunting in packs.
Month one. You start talking to yourself.
You forget what other people's laughter sounds like.
Until one night... something answers.
That voice? It's your brain.
In one study, just fifteen minutes in total darkness made people see faces.
When there's no one... your brain makes them up.
That's what breaks you first. Not hunger. Loneliness.
Studies show long-term loneliness can be as harmful to your body as smoking.
Year one. Grass covers the roads. Deer walk the city.
Year ten. Everything rusts.
Year one hundred. The city is a forest.
Ten thousand years later... almost no trace of us is left.
And you... are the last one who remembers us.
The world doesn't need us. But we need each other.
So message someone you miss. Right now.
Comment: what's the first thing you'd do if you were the last one left?
